readOnly.description:
If true, zip file will not be written to remote.
Has a default value so getMissing will not try to get the retriever again when readOnly is not set.

fabricateSources.description: If true, when loading a seeded read-only retriever, `initialize` will also call `populateSourceFilesForName`

sourcesFabricated.description: If #fabricateSources is true, this will be set to true if the sources have been fabricated.

indexZipUrl.description:
The url of the zipfile containing the pre-indexed data to be searched by the engine

This zipfile will contain the following:
 * docstore.tsv
 * config.json (if using FAISS)
 * index.faiss (if using FAISS)
 * codemap.json (if there are extracted code snippets)

device.description:
CPU or GPU device to use. -1 is CPU, and GPU devices can be passed as a list.
See {@link https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/cuda-pro-tip-control-gpu-visibility-cuda_visible_devices/}

indexerNodePoolMatrix.description:
A map of passage number thresholds to node pool names.

If set, and the number of passages exceeds one of the thresholds, the node pool for that threshold
will be used when adding the indexPassages call to the ActionQueue,
thus allowing indexing to happen on a specific GPU type.

maxTries.description:
Number of times an index/unindex call should be attempted asynchronously before
the call is not attempted again and the relevant {@link Genai.SourceFile}s are then
transitioned to the FAILED state.

indexingBatchSize.description:
If incremental indexing is supported, large indexing calls will be split into
batches of around this number of passages.

The passages for each source are fully read before the batch is cut off, so
if indexingBatchSize is 250000 and there are already 200000 in the current batch
and the next {@link Genai.SourceFile} to be loaded has 75000 passages, the batch
will end up having 275000 passages in it.

queryPreprocessLambda.description:
The preprocessor to use for the query before embedding.
If not set, no preprocessing will be done.
If the input to the retriever is a {@link Genai.Query}, this will be applied to the
`standaloneQuery` field.
A typical use-case would be to prefix the query with some instruction template.

projects.description: The {@link Genai.Project} this instance is linked to.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

indexActions.description: All of the index actions dispatched asynchronously for this retriever

embedderSpec.description:
The spec to pass to {@link Genai.Embedder#getEmbedder} to create a {@link GenaiCore.Embedder} for embedding
text such as passages or queries.

If no spec is provided, {@link GenaiCore.Embedder.Hf} with "mixedbread-ai/mxbai-embed-large-v1" will be used.

queryMaxlen.description:
Maximum token length of a query to look for similar passages.
Longer queries will be truncated.

engineThreadPoolSpec.description:
Configuration for {@link Genai.Retriever.Dense.Engine.DeploySpec#threadPool}.
Any fields specified here will override the defaults.

title:
This subtype exists so that we can keep two unstructured dense retrievers 'warm' (i.e. loaded in memory) at the
same time. This type will always be used for the {@link Genai.Project.Settings#tutorialProject}.
name: Genai.Retriever.Dense.Tutorial
